adversarialCases.description: Reversed CanAssignTo (Role->Activity) silently misses conflict; canonical (Activity->Role) catches ACTIVITY_CONFLICT
Namespacing identifiers by origin (law: vs enterprise:) prevents cross-model closure interaction
Con passes (0 contradictions) while OntologyChecker catches missing required activity (ONTOLOGY_GAP)
Delegation conferring a prohibited activity onto a barred role triggers DELEGATION_LAUNDERS_PROHIBITION and ACTIVITY_CONFLICT
All negation patterns (shall not, no person shall, is prohibited from) strictly map to Deny polarity
